svg.aria-label: F171.1 a photo or a PDF reaches a tool: the interface design, the model
svg.title: F171.1 a photo or a PDF reaches a tool: the interface design, the model

g.text: F171.1 a photo or a PDF reaches a tool: the interface design, the model
a usage scope of purpose tool (7)

text.tspan: The host builds ToolModels, each model wrapped once so its calls are traced, replayed and written to the ledger as tool rows, and hands it to the program's catalogue. The catalogue gives each pack the model it picks, and the pack hands it to its
tool's constructor. The number in brackets is the step that builds it.
